svg.title: HUC-12 routing evidence map
svg.desc: Source WBD HUC-12 polygons colored by outgoing routing evidence in the derived accounting network. Polygon boundaries are not stream routes. Run v01a_unit_pulse_strict, period unit_pulse_no_time; Synthetic diagnostic inputs.

g.text: WBD polygon geography; fill classifies each HUC's outgoing accounting link.
Unresolved links are project inferences; official connectors are not physical channels.
This map reports routing provenance, not measured transport or channel geometry.
